input_distribution: CPU torch.Generator manual_seed; randint(-8192,8193,int32).float()/16; exact binary fractions
reference: CPU FP64 from the same FP32 values, cast to FP32; bit-exact equality
cache_note: No cache flush. Repeated addresses are warm by reuse, not a claim of L2 residency. Ring4 cycles four fixed input/output pairs; not a DRAM bandwidth experiment.
timing_mode: CUDA Events on one explicit stream, enclosing CUDA Graph replays
graph_note: One fixed graph per cache policy; A and A_prime are aliases of the SAME graph. Ring begins at index zero per replay, 128 divisible by 4.
order: A,A_prime on even pairs; A_prime,A on odd pairs; invert first order in odd sessions
included: 128*replays device kernel nodes plus graph/device scheduling gaps within Event timestamps
excluded: JIT compilation, allocation, input generation, CPU reference, capture, warmup, correctness checks, telemetry, transfers
clock_policy: do not alter clocks or power limits; sample nvidia-smi before and after each cache policy
statistics: per-pair A_ms/A_prime_ms; geometric mean; deterministic percentile bootstrap of pair log ratios, 10000 resamples, seed 3070; exploratory only
